Ad creatives · Video scripts · Meta

Video ad scripts

Three talking-to-camera scripts, each around 30 to 45 seconds, in your own voice.

Script 1 · “He went quiet”

Hook (0 to 3s)

“Here’s what a secure woman does when he goes quiet.”

Body

“It isn’t sending three texts. It isn’t pretending she doesn’t care either. She notices the urge, pauses, and responds from a calm place, on her own timing. That pause is a skill, and it can be learned.”

CTA

“I’m teaching a free live class called The Secure Woman. Tap Sign up to save your seat. The replay is included.”

Shot: close-up talking to camera, your pink and glam setup, phone in hand.

Script 2 · “Detachment isn’t a game”

Hook (0 to 3s)

“Detachment is not playing hard to get.”

Body

“Playing games is still about him. Real detachment is about you: staying connected to your own life, your own plans and your own worth, whether he texts back in five minutes or five hours.”

CTA

“In my free class I’ll show you what that looks like day to day, with real scripts. Tap Sign up below.”

Shot: talking to camera, on-screen text “detachment” in Playfair italic.

Script 3 · “Hot, then cold”

Hook (0 to 3s)

“Hot one week, cold the next. Let’s talk about that pattern.”

Body

“When a man is warm one week and distant the next, it’s easy to work harder to get the warm version back. Learning to spot avoidant and unavailable patterns early means you can decide with a clear head.”

CTA

“Join my free live class, The Secure Woman. Sixty minutes, replay included. Tap Sign up to save your seat.”

Shot: talking to camera, cut to a text thread on screen (names blurred).
